title: Google in talks with China's Envicool, others to buy data centre cooling systems, sources say
title_zh: 消息人士称，谷歌正在与中国 Envicool 等公司洽谈购买数据中心冷却系统
summary: Alphabet's Google is in talks with Envicool and other Chinese firms about buying liquid cooling equipment for data centres, according to people with knowledge of a visit to China by one ‌of the U.S. firm's procurement teams.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，Alphabet 旗下的谷歌正在与 Envicool 和其他中国公司就购买数据中心液体冷却设备进行谈判，这家美国公司的采购团队曾访问过中国。

title: US government confirms Tesla and LG Energy Solution's $4.3 billion battery deal
title_zh: 美国政府确认特斯拉和 LG Energy Solution 价值 43 亿美元的电池交易
summary: By Kanishka Singh WASHINGTON, March 16 (Reuters) - The U.S. government on Monday said electric vehicle maker Tesla and South Korea's LG Energy Solution had signed a supply agreement to build a $4.3
summary_zh: 路透华盛顿 3 月 16 日 - 美国政府周一表示，电动汽车制造商特斯拉和韩国 LG Energy Solution 已签署供应协议，将建造 4.3 美元的电动汽车工厂。

title: Nvidia Makes Trillion-Dollar Forecast at Annual Product Expo
title_zh: Nvidia 在年度产品博览会上做出万亿美元的预测
summary: During a 2 1/2-hour keynote address, Huang announced plans to push deeper into central processing units — Intel Corp.’s home turf — and introduced semiconductors made with technology acquired from startup Groq.
summary_zh: 在长达 2 1/2 小时的主题演讲中，黄仁勋宣布计划深入推进中央处理器（英特尔公司的主场），并推出了采用从初创公司 Groq 收购的技术制造的半导体。

title: Nvidia goes all in on AI vision at GTC: Takeaways from CEO keynote
title_zh: Nvidia 在 GTC 上全力推进人工智能愿景：CEO 主题演讲要点
summary: Nvidia's (NVDA) GTC 2026 event — the so-called "Super Bowl of AI" — kicked off on Monday with a keynote address from CEO Jensen Huang, where the chip executive announced the launch of the new NemoClaw stack open source AI agent platform OpenClaw, heightened demand for Blackwel...
summary_zh: Nvidia (NVDA) 的 GTC 2026 活动——所谓的“人工智能超级碗”——于周一拉开帷幕，首席执行官黄仁勋发表了主题演讲，这位芯片高管宣布推出新的 NemoClaw 堆栈开源人工智能代理平台 OpenClaw，增加了对 Blackwel 的需求……

title: Wall Street ends higher as traders return to AI stocks
title_zh: 随着交易员重返人工智能股票，华尔街收高
summary: STORY: Wall Street's main indexes ended higher on Monday, with the Dow gaining more than eight-tenths of a percent, the S&P 500 adding one percent and the Nasdaq climbing nearly one-and-a-quarter percent.:: FileOil prices dropped modestly after the U.S.
summary_zh: 故事：华尔街主要股指周一收高，道琼斯指数上涨逾十分之八，标准普尔 500 指数上涨 1%，纳斯达克指数上涨近四分之一。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures slip after stocks bounce back amid 3-week losing streak
title_zh: 今日股市：道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数、纳斯达克期货在连续 3 周下跌后反弹后下跌
summary: Investors are parsing the information out of Nvidia's highly anticipated GTC event.
summary_zh: 投资者正在从 Nvidia 备受期待的 GTC 活动中解析信息。

title: Samsung shares rise after Nvidia's Huang flags tie-up on new AI chips
title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋宣布与新人工智能芯片合作后，三星股价上涨
summary: Shares of Samsung Electronics rose as much as 5% on Tuesday after Nvidia CEO ‌Jensen Huang said the South Korean company was producing ‌Nvidia's new artificial intelligence chips.
summary_zh: 在英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示这家韩国公司正在生产英伟达的新型人工智能芯片后，三星电子股价周二上涨了 5%。

title: Nvidia launches Groq 3 AI chip and CPU server aimed at Intel during GTC 2026
title_zh: Nvidia 在 GTC 2026 期间推出针对英特尔的 Groq 3 AI 芯片和 CPU 服务器
summary: Nvidia on Monday unveiled its new Groq 3 processor and its effort to take on Intel in the CPU space during the chipmaker's GTC event.
summary_zh: Nvidia 周一在该芯片制造商的 GTC 活动期间推出了新的 Groq 3 处理器，并在 CPU 领域与英特尔展开了较量。

title: Okta CEO: AI is moving so quickly, companies must change 40% of what they are doing every year
title_zh: Okta首席执行官：人工智能发展如此之快，公司每年必须改变40%的工作
summary: Okta co-founder & CEO Todd McKinnon serves up a reality check to companies looking to survive the AI revolution.
summary_zh: Okta 联合创始人兼首席执行官托德·麦金农 (Todd McKinnon) 为那些希望在人工智能革命中生存下来的公司提供了现实检验。
